summary: Releases a stored COM interface pointer by invoking the method at vtable offset 40 (0x28) on the non-null pointer, then nulls the storage slot and returns 0. No-op when the stored pointer is already null.

local_names.this: storage slot holding the COM interface pointer
local_names.obj: dereferenced stored interface pointer used to reach the vtable
local_names.vtbl_method: indirectly called method at vtable entry 40 (0x28)

operations.description: If the stored interface pointer *this is non-null, proceed to release it; otherwise skip the call.
Indirect call through the stored interface vtable entry at offset 40 (0x28), passing the interface pointer as the single argument.
Set the storage slot *this to 0 after the release call.

unresolved: Exact identity of the vtable+40 (0x28) method (Release vs Unlock vs other) is not confirmed.
